content.value: A preston cable 20 m long is to be tensioned from one end to an initial prestress of 1100 MPa immediately after transfer. Assume that there is no slack in the cable, that the shrinkage of concrete is 0.00025 at time of transfer, and that the average compression in concrete is 6.0 MPa along the length of the tendon. $E _ { c } = 2 6 , 0 0 0$ MPa and $E _ { s } = 2 0 0 , 0 0 0 ~ \mathsf { M P a }$ . Compute the length of shims required, neglecting any elastic shortening of the shims and any friction along the tendon.
